cv.selection: minimum pooled validation MSE; ties prefer smaller q then smaller size sum
cv.preprocessing: No estimated preprocessing: generated Gaussian covariates use fixed population covariance; supports searched from inner training only.

independent_test.definition: SHA256 of shape/dtype/bytes array digests of X,y,signal in each shared batch

runtime_interpretation: Rescoring methods share the complete candidate search cost; their runtime values must not be summed as independent fits.
